## [0.32.1] - 2026-09-17

Density no longer shrinks things that need a floor of their own, and a few
layout glitches that came with fixing it are cleaned up too. Read this before
updating if you use anything other than Default density.

### Fixed

- **The tab strip, drawer header, response toolbar, and update/recovery banners hold a fixed height at every density** instead of shrinking as low as 24px at Default.
- **Every interactive control now clears the 24x24px touch-target minimum at every density** - switches, checkboxes, toasts, dialog and tab close buttons, the history sidebar's pin/delete buttons, and icon-only buttons throughout collections and the Elements tab no longer shrink as low as 21px, 15px, 12px or smaller.
- **Icons hold a fixed 16px (or 12px for compact icons) floor** instead of shrinking to 9px at Default density.
- The response body's Pretty/Raw switch spilled past the bottom of its toolbar, and the Elements tab's enable switch touched the top and bottom of its row - both now sit with room around them.
- A segmented control (the load test dialog's Response format, and the client certificate form's Format) rendered beside its label instead of under it.
- Text fields held their value closer to the border than the rest of the app's controls.
- **The enable checkbox in the request/response key-value rows and the variables tables rendered as a barely-rounded flat square** instead of the app's rounded, accent-coloured control - both now share one properly styled checkbox.
- **Validation messages across the app now speak in plain language** instead of echoing an internal identifier, a raw wire key or a 0-based array index: element and load-run step errors name the item by its label and position (e.g. "Throughput" or "'Assert status code' (item 2)"), Settings and the load test dialog's budgets name the field the way its own control does ("Worker Threads", "p99 latency"), a mock server that can't be found says so in plain English, and a schema-mismatch error ("must be a number", "must be one of [...]") is rebuilt from the schema's own declared title and bounds instead of quoting the validator's internal wording.

### Changed

- **The load test dialog's Comment field moved to the top**, above Load profile, so a run can be named before it starts instead of found later behind Recording & limits.
- **The load test dialog's Scripts control moved after the load profile summary**, since that summary is still describing the profile fields directly above it and Scripts is the first control that isn't about the profile.
